scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,mobile,tv,play,admin -c red,magenta,cyan,green,yellow "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w apps/mobile" "npm run dev -w apps/tv" "npm run dev -w apps/play" "npm run dev -w apps/admin"
scripts.dev:fresh: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('server/data/world.json', { force: true })" && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/mobile && npm run build -w apps/tv && npm run build -w apps/play && npm run build -w apps/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && tsc --noEmit -p packages && tsc --noEmit -p apps && npm run typecheck -w apps/mobile && npm run typecheck -w apps/tv && npm run typecheck -w apps/play && npm run typecheck -w apps/admin
